title: Does the flat limit argument extend to a formal proof that the hyperbolic and spherical Ceva hold

problemStatement.plain: Formal investigation in geometry: Does the flat limit argument extend to a formal proof that the hyperbolic and spherical Ceva hold.

knowledge.progressSummary: COMPLETED (SURVEY): Question already answered by existing formalization. The flat limit IS formalized (spherical_flat_limit, hyperbolic_flat_limit), connecting non-Euclidean to Euclidean as curvature → 0. The actual proofs use algebraic abstraction via GeneralizedCevianConfig, not the flat limit.

insights: The flat limit argument IS formalized: spherical_flat_limit and hyperbolic_flat_limit prove sin(x)/x → 1 and sinh(x)/x → 1
However the non-Euclidean Ceva theorems are NOT proved via flat limit — they use a generalized algebraic framework (GeneralizedCevianConfig)
The flat limit serves as a consistency check connecting all three geometries, not as the proof mechanism
